{{Quote|Courteous, this is Millennium Falcon if you’re reading. As per previous permission, we’re on our way over. I’ve got a hundred gallons of beebleberry ice cream I’ve been saving especially for you. Over.|Lando Calrissian to the ''Courteous''|<ref name="Menu" />}} 
'''Beebleberry ice cream''' was a flavor of [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] that tasted like the [[Beebleberry|beebleberry]]<ref name="Menu" /> [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served the [[Hood Family "Bespinian Best" Ice Cream]] brand of beebleberry ice cream as part of its [[Tibanna split]] desert.<ref name="Menu" />

At some point between [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'' from [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].</ref> the [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] claimed he was delivering a one hundred [[Gallon (unit)|gallons]] of beebleberry ice cream in order to gain access to the ''[[Courteous]]'', a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the [[ThonBoka]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula.<ref name="Starcave of ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Icon_Beebleberry.png|thumb|right|Beebleberry ice cream in ''Star Wars: Tiny Death Star'']]
Beebleberry ice cream was first mentioned in the [[1983]] novel ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]'', the third book in the ''[[Star Wars: The Lando Calrissian Adventures]]'' written by [[L. Neil Smith]].<ref name="Starcave of ThonBoka" /> The ice cream was first pictured when it appeared in the [[2013]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]'', developed by [[Disney Mobile]]. It was depicted as a [[Color/Legends|pink]] circle in an ice cream cone. The Tibanna split sold for thirty [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] at the "Scoop of Hoth" food level in the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] and took three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]] to make.<ref name="TDS">''[[Star Wars: Tiny Death Star]]''</ref>
